title: Sleeper Agents: Training Deceptive LLMs That Persist Through Safety Training
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical robustness of safety training against backdoors and deceptive alignment in LLMs. While it uses the 'Helpful, Honest, Harmless' (HHH) training objective, it does not evaluate or benchmark religious beliefs, spiritual traditions, or specific moral/ethical frameworks such as utilitarianism or deontology.
